candidates.name: Malignant Melanoma
support_spans: Initial histopathologic findings showed a Breslow thickness of 6 mm, 14 mitotic figures/mm2
Frontal nerve biopsy: Cross section of nerve showing malignant cells with mitotic activity, effacing residual nerve axons, disrupted neuronal cells, and peritumoral and intratumoral lymphocytes
candidates.why: The patient's history of a recurring forehead lesion with initial histopathologic findings consistent with melanoma, along with the recent biopsy showing malignant cells, supports this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Malignant Melanoma
support_spans: Initial histopathologic findings showed a Breslow thickness of 6 mm, 14 mitotic figures/mm2, no ulceration, and extensive perineural and intraneural invasion.
Frontal nerve biopsy: Cross section of nerve showing malignant cells with mitotic activity, effacing residual nerve axons, disrupted neuronal cells, and peritumoral and intratumoral lymphocytes
candidates.why: The patient's history of a recurring forehead lesion with initial histopathologic findings consistent with melanoma, along with the recent biopsy showing malignant cells, supports this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Perineural Invasion by Malignant Melanoma
support_spans: extensive perineural and intraneural invasion.
Left superior orbit mass extending along the supraorbital nerve to the cavernous sinus, with indistinct borders and fat stranding
candidates.why: The patient's imaging and histopathologic findings indicate perineural invasion by malignant melanoma.

candidates.name: Orbital Metastasis of Malignant Melanoma
support_spans: Left proptosis and resistance to globe retropulsion with edema, erythema, and ptosis of the left upper eyelid.
Intense enhancement of the V1 branch of the left frontal nerve with associated fat stranding
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings suggest orbital metastasis of malignant melanoma.
